plugins.name: Anthropic Messages
plugins.description: Talks to Anthropic's Messages API and to endpoints that speak it.

plugins.name: Chat Completions
plugins.description: Talks to OpenAI-style chat completion endpoints: OpenAI, OpenRouter, Gemini, Groq, DeepSeek, Mistral and local servers.

plugins.name: Gemini API
plugins.description: Talks to Gemini's own API (Interactions) for chat, transcription and voices: every audio format, Gemini 3's thought signatures carried exactly, its usage with cached and thinking tokens, a voice that streams, Google keeping the conversation between turns, so each sends only what is new, and Google Search on a paid key, its answer shown as Google gave it.

plugins.name: Gemini Live
plugins.description: Talks to Gemini's Live API: a voice conversation in one stream, both ways, for Koe.

plugins.name: OpenAI Realtime
plugins.description: Talks to OpenAI's Realtime API: a voice conversation in one stream, both ways, for Koe.

plugins.name: OpenAI Responses
plugins.description: Talks to OpenAI's Responses API and to servers that speak it, OpenAI keeping the conversation between turns, so each sends only what is new, and the stored responses deleted when annai is told to.

plugins.name: PDF pages
plugins.description: Shows a PDF's pages as pictures to models that see photos but can't read PDFs, and draws a PDF's first page for its preview in any browser. It brings Mozilla's PDF.js, about 4.5 MB.

plugins.name: Custom provider
plugins.description: Any other server: an OpenAI-compatible one, a router or proxy, or a server you run. Give its address, and annai looks for what it offers, at no cost.

plugins.name: Anthropic
plugins.description: Claude models through Anthropic's Messages API, with web search, and a cache that can last an hour.

plugins.name: DeepSeek
plugins.description: DeepSeek's models, with their reasoning shown as they think.

plugins.name: Google Gemini
plugins.description: Gemini models through Google's own API, with Google Search on a paid key, its transcription and voices, and Gemini Live for a voice conversation.

plugins.name: Groq
plugins.description: Fast open models, and fast Whisper transcription.

plugins.name: llama.cpp
plugins.description: Models on a llama.cpp server you run (llama-server), or one built on it such as Unsloth Studio or KoboldCpp. Their thinking is switched off for quick decisions.

plugins.name: LM Studio
plugins.description: Models on LM Studio's server.

plugins.name: Local speech server
plugins.description: Transcription and a voice from a server you run, such as Speaches, whisper.cpp or Kokoro.

plugins.name: Mistral
plugins.description: Mistral's models.

plugins.name: Ollama
plugins.description: Models on Ollama, with their thinking switched off for quick decisions.

plugins.name: OpenAI
plugins.description: GPT models through OpenAI's Responses API, with OpenAI's transcription and voices, and its Realtime voice for Koe, on one key.

plugins.name: OpenRouter
plugins.description: One key for many models, free ones among them, with transcription and voices too. Sign in with OpenRouter, or give a key.
plugins.featured: Sign in with OpenRouter is the quickest way, and it starts you on free models.

plugins.name: Scripted model (for testing)
plugins.description: A model that replies from a script, for tests and plugin authors. It never uses the network.

plugins.name: SGLang
plugins.description: Models on an SGLang server you run, with their thinking switched through the chat template.

plugins.name: vLLM
plugins.description: Models on a vLLM server you run, with their thinking switched through the chat template, and Whisper models for transcription.

plugins.name: Remote trace (for developers)
plugins.description: For developers: sends annai's trace, as the Trace screen shows it, to a server you run, while you watch. It sends nothing until you give it a server and a token and turn Send on. Never keys.

plugins.name: Scripted model
plugins.description: A model that replies from a script, for tests and plugin authors. It never uses the network.

plugins.name: SearXNG Search
plugins.description: Searches through a SearXNG instance you run. No key, no limits but your own. The instance must allow JSON and web apps.

plugins.name: Serper Search
plugins.description: Google's results through Serper, with its answer box. 2,500 free searches on sign-up, no card.

plugins.name: Tavily Search
plugins.description: Web search made for AI agents, with a snippet of each page. 1,000 free credits a month, no card.

plugins.name: OpenAI-compatible speech
plugins.description: Transcription and voices through the OpenAI audio API: OpenAI, OpenRouter, Groq and local servers such as Speaches, whisper.cpp and Kokoro.

plugins.name: Forgejo / Gitea
plugins.description: Backs up everything to a private repository on a Forgejo or Gitea server, such as your own or Codeberg: each backup is a commit, and only changed files are uploaded.

plugins.name: GitHub
plugins.description: Backs up everything to a private GitHub repository: each backup is a commit, and only changed files are uploaded.

plugins.name: S3-compatible storage
plugins.description: Backs up everything to a bucket on AWS S3, Cloudflare R2, Backblaze B2 or any S3-compatible storage, one archive file per backup.

plugins.name: WebDAV
plugins.description: Backs up everything to a folder on a WebDAV server that allows browser access, one archive file per backup.
